boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten currently documented Stanislaus State campus-spirit and graduating-class traditions.

cards.title: Wear Warrior Red on Wednesdays
cards.subtitle: Campus Spirit & Traditions
cards.notes: Plan a red outfit for Wednesday and join the ASI campus-spirit tradition; pair it with a Warrior Athletics event if one is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A weekly Warrior-pride practice promoted by ASI.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI's Campus Spirit and Traditions program encourages people to wear Warrior Red attire every Wednesday.
cards.source_title: Event Programming | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: No admission or participation cost is stated on the source page.

cards.title: Mark Stan State’s founding during StanWeek
cards.subtitle: Annual September campus celebration
cards.notes: Watch ASI event listings for the September schedule, then choose a StanWeek activity that connects the campus community to the University’s founding.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong observance commemorating Stanislaus State’s founding.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI describes StanWeek as a weeklong series of events intended to commemorate the founding of Stanislaus State.
cards.source_title: Event Programming | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: ASI lists StanWeek 2026 for September, with details to come.

cards.title: Reconnect during Homecoming Week
cards.subtitle: Annual Stan State campus-spirit week
cards.notes: Use the published Homecoming schedule to select an open activity, and check the event details before inviting alumni, friends, or family to campus.
cards.short_summary: A return-to-campus celebration centered on Warrior connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanislaus State says Homecoming is a time to bring Warriors back to campus to reconnect with friends and celebrate campus spirit.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 page lists Homecoming Week from February 16 through February 21, 2026.

cards.title: Join the Warrior Day Festival
cards.subtitle: ASI special-event tradition
cards.notes: Pick up a festival ticket through the University Student Center service desk and use the official FAQ or event listing to confirm current entry details.
cards.short_summary: A campus festival with activities, entertainment, and food vendors.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI identifies Warrior Day Festival among its major campus events and describes festival activities, entertainment, and ticket information.
cards.source_title: Event Programming | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: The listed 2026 ticket information says Stan State students are free; guest, alumni, and door prices are also listed.

cards.title: Leave a message in the Alumni Brick Plaza
cards.subtitle: Graduating Class Traditions
cards.notes: If you want a permanent graduation keepsake, review the personalization rules and submit an engraved-brick order through the Student Center’s campaign link.
cards.short_summary: A personalized-brick tradition that leaves a permanent campus tribute.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Student Center calls buying a personalized engraved brick a Stan State tradition that strengthens campus spirit.
cards.source_title: Grad Class Traditions | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: The current page lists personalized engraved bricks at $209 and anticipated installation in summer 2026.

cards.title: Prepare for commencement at Grad Fair
cards.subtitle: Graduating Class Traditions
cards.notes: Bring your graduation questions to the listed fair sessions and check the campus schedule for vendor tables, essentials, and event updates.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center graduation-preparation gathering with vendors and information booths.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Student Center includes Grad Fair in its current Graduating Class Traditions and says it provides information booths, vendors, giveaways, and graduation essentials.
cards.source_title: Grad Class Traditions | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: The current page lists Grad Fair sessions April 21–23, 2026, in the Leadership Conference Room and Bookstore.

cards.title: Pick up a graduate plate frame and decal
cards.subtitle: Graduating Class Traditions at Shield Lane
cards.notes: Bring your vehicle to Shield Lane during a listed graduate event and confirm the current distribution details with ASI and the University Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A graduate-season campus-spirit giveaway for alumni vehicles.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Student Center lists Alumni License Plates & Decals among its Graduating Class Traditions and advertises a free Stan State license plate frame and decal.
cards.source_title: Grad Class Traditions | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: Current 2026 dates are April 24 and April 29 at Shield Lane; the page says the frame and decal are free.

cards.title: Continue the Warrior look at the grad merch pop-up
cards.subtitle: Graduating Class Traditions in the Quad
cards.notes: Stop by the Quad pop-up during its posted window if you want Stan State alumni merchandise, and check with organizers for available items before you go.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-season pop-up focused on Stan State alumni merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Student Center includes a Warrior Merch Pop-Up: Grad Edition in its current Graduating Class Traditions.
cards.source_title: Grad Class Traditions | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: The current page lists the 2026 pop-up for May 13, 10 a.m.–1 p.m., in the Quad.

cards.title: Meet in the Quad after commencement
cards.subtitle: Graduating Class Traditions
cards.notes: After your ceremony, head to the Quad for the scheduled post-graduation gathering; use the event table to match the celebration to your ceremony date.
cards.short_summary: A Quad gathering for graduates to mingle, take photos, and collect keepsakes.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Student Center lists Post Commencement Celebrations as part of its Graduating Class Traditions and invites graduates to mingle, take photos, and get keepsakes.
cards.source_title: Grad Class Traditions | California State University Stanislaus
cards.access_notes: The current page lists celebrations in the Quad after commencement ceremonies from May 26 through May 29, 2026.

cards.title: Recognize the 1,960-minute giving tradition
cards.subtitle: University day-of-giving campaign
cards.notes: Follow University Advancement announcements during the annual campaign and, if you participate, direct support to a campus program, team, or student organization.
cards.short_summary: A giving campaign whose duration honors Stan State’s 1960 opening.
cards.evidence_claim: Stanislaus State introduced 1960 Minutes of Giving as a new University tradition, with 1,960 minutes chosen to honor the year the University opened.
cards.source_title: Every Minute Matters: Stan State to Host First-Ever 1960 Minutes of Giving
cards.access_notes: The official announcement describes the inaugural campaign and its 1,960-minute duration; participation details can change by year.
